segments.zh: 欢迎回来，各位英语学习者。

segments.en: My name is Marco and I am joined by...
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco，和我一起的是……

segments.en: I'm doing really well and I'm really excited about our lesson for today.
segments.zh: 我做得很好，我对我们今天的课程感到非常兴奋。

segments.en: We've got an intermediate lesson today and we're going to study some real English.
segments.zh: 我们今天有一个中级课程，我们将学习一些真正的英语。

segments.en: English that you use every day, right?
segments.zh: 你每天都在用的英语，对吧？

segments.en: English that native speakers really use.
segments.zh: 母语人士真正使用的英语。

segments.en: So today, as Erika mentioned, we have an intermediate lesson and not only is it intermediate, but it's a business lesson.
segments.zh: 所以今天，正如 Erika 所提到的，我们有一个中级课程，它不仅是中级的，而且是一个商业课。

segments.en: So today we're listening in to a sales meeting and we're going to learn some great useful English to talk about sales strategies.
segments.zh: 所以今天我们要听销售会议，我们将学习一些非常有用的英语来讨论销售策略。

segments.en: So we're going to learn English for sales strategies, for making suggestions and for responding to suggestions.
segments.zh: 因此，我们将学习英语以获取销售策略、提出建议和回应建议。

segments.en: So why don't we take a look at our vocabulary preview for today?
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不看看我们今天的词汇预览呢？

segments.en: So our vocabulary preview is a part of our lesson when we teach you some really important words that will help you to understand the dialogue better.
segments.zh: 因此，当我们教您一些非常重要的单词来帮助您更好地理解对话时，我们的词汇预览是我们课程的一部分。

segments.en: So that is what vocabulary preview is.
We have two words for you today and we can start off by looking at the first one.
segments.zh: 今天我们有两个词要告诉你，我们可以从看第一个开始。

segments.en: Our first word today is drive sales.
segments.zh: 我们今天的第一个词是推动销售。

segments.en: So now let's look at our second word and it's an interesting one.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们看看我们的第二个词，这是一个有趣的词。

segments.en: So, Erica, what is a promotion exactly?
segments.zh: 那么，Erica，究竟什么是促销活动？

segments.en: So here we're not really talking about getting a better job, right?
segments.zh: 所以在这里我们并不是真的在谈论获得更好的工作，对吧？

segments.en: We're talking about a marketing strategy.
segments.zh: 我们谈论的是营销策略。

segments.en: So I can give you an example.
segments.zh: 所以我可以给你一个例子。

segments.en: Suppose that I want to buy shampoo.
And if I go to the supermarket and I see buy one and get one free.
segments.zh: 如果我去超市，我看到买一送一。

segments.en: So that's a two for one.
That's a two for one promotion.
Perhaps the shampoo in the supermarket is less expensive than usual.
segments.zh: 也许超市里的洗发水比平时便宜。

segments.en: Maybe, yeah, usually maybe it costs $5 but today it costs $4.
segments.zh: 也许，是的，通常可能需要 5 美元，但今天要花 4 美元。

segments.en: So that's a really good marketing strategy.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常好的营销策略。

segments.en: So let's hear this word in our dialogue today.
segments.zh: 所以让我们在今天的对话中听到这个词。

segments.en: So we are ready to listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以我们准备听我们的对话。

segments.en: It's going to be pretty fast.
So it might be a little bit difficult to understand.
segments.zh: 所以可能有点难以理解。

segments.en: But don't worry if you don't understand everything because later in this lesson we're going to explain all the important words and phrases.
segments.zh: 但是，如果您不了解所有内容，请不要担心，因为在本课的后面，我们将解释所有重要的单词和短语。

segments.en: All right, people, we're holding this meeting today because we've got to do something about our sales and we need to do it now.
segments.zh: 各位，今天开会是因为销售额出了问题，我们必须马上采取行动。

segments.en: How do you plan to drive sales?
Well, in fact, we're the most expensive in the market.
segments.zh: 其实我们是市场上最贵的。

segments.en: So maybe we need to lower our prices to match the competitors.
segments.zh: 也许我们该降价，和竞争对手看齐。

segments.en: What kind of thinking is that?
Maybe a two for one offer or something like that.
We're going to be here any minute.
Do we have any ideas yet?
segments.zh: 我们想出什么点子了吗？

segments.en: We were kind of considering a two for one offer to get more competitive.
segments.zh: 我们正在考虑推出买一送一的促销活动，以提高竞争力。

segments.en: I kind of like the sound of that.
It sounds like something we should consider.
That's just what I was thinking.
In fact, it's a brilliant idea.
segments.zh: 其实，这是个绝妙的主意。

segments.en: I'm glad we thought of that.
segments.zh: 幸好我们想到了这一点。

segments.en: Okay, so an interesting manager, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，一个有趣的经理，对吧？

segments.en: Maybe I would think bad manager.
segments.zh: 也许我会说这是个糟糕的经理。

segments.en: We're going to talk about him later on in the show.
segments.zh: 我们稍后会在节目中谈论他。

segments.en: But now, let's take a look at our language takeaway.
segments.zh: 但是现在，我们来看看语言要点。

segments.en: Okay, so language takeaway is the part of our lesson where we teach you the most important words from the dialogue.
segments.zh: 好的，所以语言要点是我们课程的一部分，我们教你对话中最重要的单词。

segments.en: All these words that we are going to focus on can be found in today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们将要关注的所有这些话都可以在今天的对话中找到。

segments.en: So we have three words for you today.
segments.zh: 所以我们今天有三个字要讲。

segments.en: Let's look at the first one.
So we have some examples for you so you can listen and try and see if you can figure out what match the competitors really means.
segments.zh: 因此，我们为你准备了一些例句，你可以听一听，看看能不能弄明白 match the competitors 到底是什么意思。

segments.en: We guarantee that we can match the competitors' lowest price.
segments.zh: 我们保证我们可以匹配竞争对手的最低价格。

segments.en: It's impossible for us to match the competitors.
segments.zh: 我们无法匹配竞争对手。

segments.en: Our costs are just too high.
Do you think we can match our competitors' prices and still keep our quality high?
segments.zh: 您认为我们可以匹配竞争对手的价格并保持我们的质量高吗？

segments.en: So I see that match the competitors means to be as good as or better than other companies in the same industry.
segments.zh: 因此，我认为与竞争对手相匹配意味着与同一行业的其他公司一样好或更好。

segments.en: All right, so let's move to our second word today for Language Takeaways and it is in the market.
segments.zh: 好，接下来看语言要点的第二个词 in the market。

segments.en: We heard this phrase in the dialogue and it means in the industry.
segments.zh: 我们在对话中听到了这句话，这意味着在行业中。

segments.en: I can say, for example, EnglishPod is the best language pod in the market.
segments.zh: 例如，我可以说，EnglishPod 是市场上最好的语言 pod。

segments.en: So of all the podcasts that teach English, EnglishPod is the best.
segments.zh: 因此，在所有教授英语的播客中，EnglishPod 是最好的。

segments.en: Or I can give you another example.
segments.zh: 或者我可以给你另一个例子。

segments.en: iPods are the most popular MP3 players in the market.
segments.zh: iPod 是市场上最受欢迎的 MP3 播放器。

segments.en: So of all the MP3 players in the world, iPods are the most popular.
segments.zh: 因此，在世界上所有 MP3 播放器中，iPod 是最受欢迎的。

segments.en: So let's move to our final word for today and it is...
segments.zh: 所以让我们继续我们今天的最后一句话，它是...

segments.en: So this phrase sounds a little bit strange.
segments.zh: 所以这句话听起来有点奇怪。

segments.en: Are we talking about an airplane here?
segments.zh: 我们在这里谈论的是飞机吗？

segments.en: So we're going to give you some examples and try and guess what it'll never fly really means.
segments.zh: 所以我们会给你一些例子，你试着猜猜 it'll never fly 到底是什么意思。

segments.en: This marketing plan will never fly.
segments.zh: 这个营销计划根本行不通。

segments.en: What you want to sell bikinis in Alaska?
segments.zh: 什么？你想在阿拉斯加卖比基尼？

segments.en: Brad told me his idea for a film script, but the story will never fly.
segments.zh: 布拉德跟我说了他想拍的电影剧本，但这个故事根本行不通。

segments.en: So it means it won't work.
segments.zh: 所以它的意思是行不通。

segments.en: So now we've seen a lot of useful phrases and we are ready to listen to our dialogue a second time.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们看到了很多有用的短语，我们准备再次听我们的对话。

segments.en: But this time it's going to be slow.
So you'll be able to understand a little bit better and you'll be able to hear the words and phrases we were just talking about.
segments.zh: 因此，您将能够更好地理解一点，并且您将能够听到我们刚刚谈论的单词和短语。

segments.en: We're holding this meeting today because we've got to do something about our sales and we need to do it now.
segments.zh: 我们今天举行这次会议是因为我们必须对我们的销售做点什么，我们现在就需要做。

segments.en: How do you plan to drive sales, Roger?
segments.zh: 你打算如何推动销售，罗杰？

segments.en: Well, in fact, we're the most expensive in the market.
segments.zh: 其实我们是市场上最贵的。

segments.en: So maybe we need to lower our prices to match the competitors.
segments.zh: 也许我们该降价，和竞争对手看齐。

segments.en: What kind of thinking is that?
Anybody else have a better plan?
segments.zh: 还有人有更好的计划吗？

segments.en: Um, perhaps, um, a promotion, maybe a two for one offer or something like that.
segments.zh: 嗯，也许，嗯，搞个促销，比如买一送一之类的。

segments.en: The CEO will be here any minute.
Do we have any ideas yet?
segments.zh: 我们想出什么点子了吗？

segments.en: We were kind of considering a two for one offer to get more competitive.
segments.zh: 我们正在考虑推出买一送一的促销活动，以提高竞争力。

segments.en: I kind of like the sound of that.
It sounds like something we should consider.
That's just what I was thinking.
In fact, that's a brilliant idea.
segments.zh: 事实上，这是一个绝妙的主意。

segments.en: I'm glad we thought of that.
segments.zh: 幸好我们想到了这一点。

segments.en: I hope everyone understands a lot better now.
segments.zh: 我希望每个人现在都能更好地理解。

segments.en: And I hope everyone could listen out for some of those key words.
segments.zh: 我希望每个人都能听听其中一些关键词。

segments.en: So now it's time for us to take a look at Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在是我们来看看流利表达的时候了。

segments.en: So with Fluency Builder, we try to help you increase your fluency.
segments.zh: 因此，使用流利表达，我们会尽力帮助您提高流畅性。

segments.en: We take a word or phrase that you already know and show you how to say it a little bit more naturally, a little bit more like a native English speaker.
segments.zh: 我们采用您已经知道的单词或短语，并向您展示如何更自然地说出来，更像是以英语为母语的人。

segments.en: And we have three of these words for you today.
segments.zh: 我们今天有其中三个词要要讲。

segments.en: Let's start with the first one.
So often students will say something like, I'll be here soon.
segments.zh: 学生们经常会说类似的话，我很快就会到。

segments.en: They're totally fine, but I think there's a better way to say this.
segments.zh: 他们完全没问题，但我认为有更好的方式来表达这一点。

segments.en: And we heard it in the dialogue, so let's listen to what the person in the dialogue said.
segments.zh: 我们在对话中听到了它，所以让我们听听对话中的人说了什么。

segments.en: The CEO will be here any minute.
The CEO will be here any minute.

segments.zh: 所以，be here any minute 意思就是随时会到。

segments.en: It just sounds a little bit more natural.
I think I use this phrase quite often.
segments.zh: 我想我经常使用这句话。

segments.en: So, let's move on to our second phrase for Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以，让我们继续看流利表达的第二个短语。

segments.en: So, this phrase will help you to learn how to say, I'm thinking about something in a better sounding way.
segments.zh: 这个短语会帮你学会用更好听的方式表达“我正在考虑某件事”。

segments.en: So, you can say something like, we are thinking about a sales strategy.
segments.zh: 所以，你可以说，我们正在考虑销售策略。

segments.en: Or that sounds like something we should think about.
segments.zh: 或者这听起来像是我们应该考虑的事情。

segments.en: But in the dialogue, we heard something a little bit different.
segments.zh: 但在对话中，我们听到了一些不同的东西。

segments.en: It sounds like something we should consider.
It sounds like something we should consider.
So, consider sounds like a pretty natural way of saying it.
segments.zh: 所以，考虑听起来像是一种很自然的说法。

segments.en: And you know, I think it sounds really kind of smart.
segments.zh: 你知道，我认为这听起来真的很聪明。

segments.en: So, let's move on to our third word.
segments.zh: 所以，让我们继续我们的第三个词。

segments.en: Marco, you already said our third word.
segments.zh: 马可，你已经说了我们的第三个词。

segments.en: That's a great word right there.
A lot of people might say, that's a great idea or great.
segments.zh: 很多人可能会说，这是一个好主意或伟大的想法。

segments.en: But in the dialogue, we heard another way of saying the same idea.
segments.zh: 但在对话中，我们听到了另一种表达相同想法的方式。

segments.en: But I would have to say that it's a little bit more British English.
segments.zh: 但我不得不说它有点英式英语。

segments.en: But I also think it sort of gives more power to this idea that it's a good idea, brilliant idea.
segments.zh: 但我也认为它赋予了这个想法更多的力量，即这是一个好主意，绝妙的想法。

segments.en: And it's a really, really good idea.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常非常好的想法。

segments.en: So, we're ready to listen to our dialogue again a third time, but at its normal speed.
segments.zh: 因此，我们准备再次聆听我们的对话，但速度正常。

segments.en: We're holding this meeting today because we've got to do something about our sales and we need to do it now.
segments.zh: 我们今天举行这次会议是因为我们必须对我们的销售做点什么，我们现在就需要做。

segments.en: How do you plan to drive sales?
Well, in fact, we're the most expensive in the market.
segments.zh: 其实我们是市场上最贵的。

segments.en: So maybe we need to lower our prices to match the competitors.
segments.zh: 也许我们该降价，和竞争对手看齐。

segments.en: What kind of thinking is that?
Maybe a two-for-one offer or something like that.
segments.zh: 也许是买一送一之类的。

segments.en: The CEO will be here any minute.
Do we have any ideas yet?
segments.zh: 我们想出什么点子了吗？

segments.en: We were kind of considering a two-for-one offer to get more competitive.
segments.zh: 我们正在考虑推出买一送一的活动，让自己更有竞争力。

segments.en: I kind of like the sound of that.
It sounds like something we should consider.
That's just what I was thinking.
In fact, it's a brilliant idea.
segments.zh: 其实，这是个绝妙的主意。

segments.en: I'm glad we thought of that.
segments.zh: 幸好我们想到了这一点。

segments.en: So listening to this dialogue makes you think about this boss.
segments.zh: 所以听这个对话会让你想起这个老板。

segments.en: I'm pretty sure everyone has had a manager or a supervisor that's similar to this guy.
segments.zh: 我很确定每个人都有一个与这个人相似的经理或主管。

segments.en: Yeah, this boss, Clark, I would have to say he sounds like a terrible person to work for.
segments.zh: 是的，这位老板，克拉克，我得说他听起来是个很难共事的人。

segments.en: If you're a manager, you want to motivate your employees.
segments.zh: 如果你是一名经理，你想激励你的员工。

segments.en: I think it's the most important thing a manager does is to encourage his or her employees and to help support them to grow and to be better people in the job.
segments.zh: 我认为经理所做的最重要的事情是鼓励他或她的员工，并帮助支持他们成长并成为更好的工作人员。

segments.en: And this guy is totally not doing this.
segments.zh: 而这家伙完全没有这样做。

segments.en: And you can tell because they are a little bit scared of talking and he cuts them off with saying, oh, it's a bad idea.
segments.zh: 你可以说，因为他们有点害怕说话，他打断了他们，说，哦，这是一个坏主意。

segments.en: Give me a better idea and stuff like that.
segments.zh: 给我个更好的主意之类的。

segments.en: Yeah, I could never work for a guy like this.
segments.zh: 是的，我永远不能为这样的人工作。

segments.en: You know, my first boss that I had when I first entered the workforce, I was in a very junior position and I was working for a large company and the general manager of the company, he was amazing.
segments.zh: 你知道，我刚开始工作时，我的第一个老板——当时我职位很低，在一家大公司上班，公司的总经理非常了不起。

segments.en: He knew every single employee's name, first name, and he would make an effort to stop and say hello and ask them how things were going.
segments.zh: 他知道每一位员工的名字，连名都记得，还会特意停下来打个招呼，问问他们近来如何。

segments.en: This left me with such a good feeling about the company that I really wanted to work hard for this company and try my best.
segments.zh: 这让我对公司有如此好的感觉，以至于我真的很想为这家公司努力工作并尽力而为。

segments.en: And I think that I've never met such a great boss as this guy.
segments.zh: 而且我认为我从未见过像这个人这样伟大的老板。

segments.en: Especially if you have a boss that's encouraging and motivating like that, it makes you work harder and makes you feel part of a really special team.
segments.zh: 特别是如果你有一个像这样鼓励和激励的老板，它会让你更加努力地工作，让你感觉自己是一个非常特别的团队的一部分。

segments.en: And that's something we can all agree on.
segments.zh: 这是我们都可以同意的事情。

segments.en: And I'm sure all our managers out there do the same.
segments.zh: 我相信我们所有的经理都这样做。

segments.en: I hope some of our listeners log on to our website and maybe they can tell us some experiences with bad managers or good managers or if they are managers, how they handle things.
segments.zh: 我希望我们的一些听众登录我们的网站，也许他们可以告诉我们一些与坏经理或优秀经理的经验，或者如果他们是经理，他们如何处理事情。

segments.en: And hopefully they can use some of these great phrases that we talked about today.
segments.zh: 希望他们可以使用我们今天谈到的一些很棒的短语。

segments.en: And be sure everyone to visit our website at EnglishPod.com and where you can find a lot of other information and really good resources to continue improving your English.
segments.zh: 并确保每个人都访问我们的网站 englishpod.com，在那里您可以找到许多其他信息和非常好的资源来继续提高您的英语水平。

segments.en: So thanks for listening today everyone and until next time, this is goodbye.
segments.zh: 感谢大家今天的收听，我们下次再见。
